ISRO Denies Privatisation Amid Private Sector Collaboration Reports

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has denied reports and concerns that it is being privatised. ISRO stated that its importance will not diminish and that private sector participation will allow the agency to focus on next-generation space programs. The agency clarified that while it will not be privatised, private firms may be involved in building rockets and satellites. ISRO Chairman Pawan Goenka also rejected privatisation fears, stating the agency's role will not diminish. The clarification comes amid reports of increased private sector involvement in India's space sector.
